core_pattern.description: Template for core dump filename, or pipe command (starting with '|'). Supports % specifiers.

core_uses_pid.description: Non-zero: append .PID to core filename (if core_pattern lacks %p). Deprecated but functional.

suid_dumpable.description: Dump policy for privileged processes (0=never,1=if dumpable,2=always (requires safe core_pattern)).

core_pipe_limit.description: Max concurrent pipe-core handlers. 0 = unlimited concurrency, no waiting.

core_dump_filter.description: Hex bitmask controlling which memory segments are included in the core dump.

systemd_coredump_dir.description: Documentation-only: location of systemd-managed core dumps.
